verdicts.explanation: Li0.25Sr2Co2O5 is the one-Li-per-cell composition, and the paper's Conclusions give 1.20 × 10−3 S·cm−1 at room temperature (T = 300 K) for x = 0.25. The 0.28 eV barrier and computed origin are also stated, and all secondary fields are correctly null.

Li0.75Sr2Co2O5 is the three-Li composition, and the Conclusions give 1.17 × 10−2 S·cm−1 at room temperature for x = 0.75, with the 0.17 eV barrier. The values are computed in this paper, and the secondary fields are correctly null.
